rules: Document references standards TAB 001 through TAB 098 covering machining features, seating surfaces, threads, splines, and component geometries
Component families indexed as 66300-A through 66600 covering various shaft types, gears, and mechanical elements
training_guidance: This index page maps technical standards (TAB series) to specific machining features and component families used in Bonfiglioli gearboxes
Standards TAB 001-TAB 018 define grinding wheels, threading tools, centering, sealing surfaces, bearing seats, threads, chamfers, splines, drilling, and keyways
Component families 66300-66600 define shaft variants (piston, solar, hollow, with splines/seals) and gear types (planetary, sun, ring, plane)
An NX agent should reference these TAB standards when modeling corresponding features on shafts, gears, and housings
The index provides traceability between geometric feature requirements and the detailed technical sheets that follow in the handbook
summary: Page 13 is a comprehensive index listing technical standards (TAB 001–TAB 098) and component families (66300–66600) covered in the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook. It maps machining features such as bearing seats, seal seats, threads, splines, keyways, and chamfers to their respective standards, and indexes component families including various shaft types and gears. This index serves as a navigation reference for the detailed engineering rules and drawings that follow in subsequent pages.
